SSL is misconfigured: HTTPS presents a *.secureserversites.net cert that does not match the domain (verified by openssl s_client during approach selection); the canonical site responds on HTTP at www.13therapeutics.com (verified curl 200). Per Rule 9, no anti-bot bypass was used; we used the HTTP response the site itself serves. (e) catalog.sku_count = 0 — the site has 'Products' and 'Peptide Therapeutics' pages but no commercial product SKUs; the 'products' page lists two preclinical drug candidates (P13 family, P7 family) which are pipeline assets, not catalog products; sku_count=0 is the correct value for a preclinical biotech with no commercial inventory; (f) catalog.search_filter_capabilities — there is no catalog UI; the products page is a static description of two pipeline candidates; the P13 and P7 sub-pages are EMPTY of body content (only navigation + footer). The 'sample_product_url' is products.html and 'sample_product_name' is the most-described pipeline asset (P13); all numeric / pricing / disclaimer fields are 'uncertain' because the company is preclinical and these fields would be fabrication; (h) product_page_anatomy.coa_present = false — no COA system because this is a preclinical biotech, not a peptide vendor; coa_hosting = 'none' is verified by absence (the navigation has no COA / certificate / quality / batch link, and no on-site references to COAs were observed across all 16 fetched pages); (i) product_page_anatomy.lab_partner_named = 'Oregon Health and Science University (OHSU)' — verified by company.md L31, which states the company is an OHSU spin-out and 'subcontracts with OHSU and other academic instututions for animal model testing' (typo 'instututions' is verbatim from the page); (j) product_page_anatomy.batch_lot_transparency = false — no commercial product, no batches; (k) trust_compliance.research_use_only_phrasing — the fetched pages do not contain any 'For Research Use Only' / 'Not for human consumption' / similar phrasing, because this is a drug-development company preparing peptides for clinical use, not a research-supply vendor selling RUO product; 'uncertain' is honest; (l) trust_compliance.tos_url / tos_highlights / refund_policy / shipping_policy — explicitly probed at /privacy.html, /privacy-policy.html, /terms.html, /terms-of-service.html, /tos.html, /shipping.html, /refund.html — all returned HTTP 404 (curl probes 2026-05-07T01:20Z); the site has no published TOS, privacy policy, or refund/shipping policy at standard URL patterns.
